items.title: Darius Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 29, 2024
items.q: even if I’ve played Cecil Taylor, which I don’t

ctx.x: Look sometimes I wish I didn’t have to devote so much program space to “Blue Rondo” and “Take Five.” But I know that’s — in a way it’s too bad because it’s kind of — it’s an understood contract with the audience and it’s silly to deny that expectation. I mean people come to a concert to have a good time you know. And you don’t want to say well that’s wrong. And it’s, you know again it’s benefitted me terrifically to know that with that platform I can play a lot of original music, and my main — well my programming…

bringing something from my hemisphere, my side of the Atlantic that they loved, they do pretty well but they always want to learn more about that. But then since I left South Africa I hardly do them. I play original music because people don’t need to pay 20 pounds to hear what they could hear in the back of a pub.
